reason: Confirmed: server/src/telemetry.rs:176 now uses `MAX(COALESCE(last_contact, 0), ?)`, but no test exercises a reception older than the stored last contact. TC-027/TC-030/TC-038 only send in increasing order, so reverting to `SET last_contact = ?` passes the suite. The R2-01 blocking todo required this test, and TS-TELEMETRY-007 ('only when it is later than the stored value') is unproven.

Add a second case (or assertion on another device) where `last_contact` is NULL and becomes the fix's `received_at`, guarding the `COALESCE`. Check that the test fails with `SET last_contact = ?`.
